entities.summary: Prince Phet, later known as King Thai Sa and formally styled as the King of Banyongrattanat Palace, was the King of the Ayutthaya Kingdom from 1709 to 1733 and the third ruler of the Ban Phlu Luang dynasty. The name "Thai Sa" refers to the Banyongrattanat Palace, which was located by a pool where he often resided.
